summary: Bitterroot NF platform lookout in Idaho County; 1930s platform tower and log cabin, abandoned in the 1960s; sources disagree; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Platform tower one mile south of the summit; most entries add a log cabin
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists the platform as gone; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site as a hike-in

events.note: Platform tower and log cabin, dated only to the 1930s by the sources
Abandoned in the 1960s per the firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts entries; the 1973 entry says before 1940 (see resolved_conflicts)

evidence.supports: 1930s log cabin and platform tower one mile south of summit; abandoned 1960s
evidence.quote: 1930s: log cabin, platform tower 1 mile south of summit. Abandoned 1960s.

evidence.supports: platform tower one mile south of summit
evidence.quote: Platform tower one mile south of summit

evidence.supports: 1973 draft entry: no building, always a tent camp, abandoned before 1940
evidence.quote: It never had a building and was always a tent camp. It was abandoned before 1940.

evidence.supports: 1973 entry: point cleared, lightning protection on poles
evidence.quote: 1973: "The point was cleared and had a lightning protection on poles

evidence.supports: draft history by O.F. Schumaker (Bitterroot National Forest History)
evidence.quote: Draft: Bitterroot National Forest History, by O.F. Schumaker

evidence.supports: index lists the platform as gone

corrections.why: firelookout.com gives the location as Idaho County, Idaho

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Most entries describe a 1930s platform tower with a log cabin. A 1973 entry quoting a draft Bitterroot history says the point never had a building and was always a tent camp. The story gives the majority account and reports the other.
Most entries say it was abandoned in the 1960s. The 1973 entry says before 1940. The story gives the 1960s date and flags the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Thin, secondary sources only. Two real disagreements, both kept in the story: cabin versus tent camp, and abandoned in the 1960s versus before 1940. Staffing: Idaho Fire Lookouts documents none, so none is written. No source describes the site today. Access is recorded only as the hike-in label; no public-access status was found. The brief county 'Idaho' is corrected to Idaho County.
